full_suite.warning: Starlette deprecates its httpx TestClient fallback in favour of httpx2.

baseline.interpretation: Two exposed deterministic development cases; not generative-answer quality.

database_restart.command: pg_ctl restart -m fast on the disposable test cluster

review.source_review: Independent agent checked downloaded HTML, revision, exact clause, hashes, spans and reference labels. No human or independent-canon corroboration is claimed.

continuation.scope: Docker installer, documentation and saved acceptance artifacts; unchanged application/configuration.
continuation.method: Independent parallel Standards and Spec agents inspected changes and recorded evidence; neither reran installation or containers.

compose.database_and_api_restart: Identical CLI and citation responses, without running the seed again.
compose.cleanup: Acceptance containers and project network removed after verification; named PostgreSQL volume retained. Docker daemon remains active and enabled.

commit_basis: File fingerprints in baseline.json identify the exercised application before its first Git commit.
